title: OpenCode global event frame (GlobalEvent envelope)
description: Envelope of one frame received on GET /global/event (SSE data payload). Pinned to the OpenCode JS SDK types.gen.ts v1.19.4 corpus snapshot d7d85817160120fd59fb27ee6ff354f45d18b994. The adapter decodes this envelope plus the event-specific properties shapes pinned in expected/pinned-events.json; unknown payload.type values decode to a pass-through Unknown event.

directory.description: Workspace directory the event belongs to. Used together with the session id to scope subscriptions; null/absent frames do not match a directory-configured subscription.

type.description: Discriminant, e.g. server.connected, session.created, session.status, session.idle, message.updated, message.part.updated, session.error, permission.updated, or any unknown future type (decoded as Unknown).

properties.description: Event-specific body. Shapes pinned per type in expected/pinned-events.json; notably session.created carries the session object directly while message.updated wraps it under info.

delta.description: Optional incremental text for message.part.updated text parts.
